title: Crispy Sheet Pan Shredded Tofu Topping

items.name: arrowroot powder or potato starch (or cornstarch)

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment.
Mix the garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, basil, and sumac in a small bowl.
Grate the tofu on the large holes of a box grater over a clean kitchen towel. Spread the shreds out, pat them dry, and tip them into a large bowl.
Add the olive oil, salt, pepper, starch, and the spice mix. Toss until no dry starch shows.
Spread the tofu across the sheet as thinly as you can. Roast 30–35 minutes, turning everything over halfway, until deep brown and crisp.
Use it on salads, grain bowls, or in wraps.
notes: A topping rather than a dish: it's the protein half of a meal, so pair it with something that has none, like the Arugula, Apple + Date Salad. Season it hard; tofu needs it. The spice mix is a template: keep the total near 4 tsp per block and change what's in it to suit what it's going on. Cutting the paprika, garlic powder, or onion powder? Make up the difference with dried basil or other dried herbs. Needs a box grater.
freezeNote: The crisp doesn't last; the source says it goes soft and chewy even in the fridge. Make only what gets eaten: a full block is the protein for two, half a block makes a side.
